style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: the counters are golden-tan wooden buttons, so the keys take their warm wood hue (darker), Enter a joyful berry/grape contrast clear of the blue, amber and green the rods wear, soft keys butter, panel a very light cream.

images.why: Student controls 'Side-by-side bay: sets consecutive numbers out as rods of counters'; Stage 'rods of counters ... the counters drawn at one size'; Delight 'the longest rod gives up its last counter, which walks across and joins the end of the shortest'. A counter a child lays in a rod is a button (IMAGES.md §3: counters, beads, tokens -> one button, bead or sweet); one skin reused for every rod and state, tinted deep blue / amber / green by code. Also the ones in the digit bay (phase 2) and the unit counters on the slate.
images.prompt: One single round wooden button seen from above, with a warm golden-tan surface, a raised rounded rim, four small dark holes in the middle and a soft glossy highlight on the rim.
